original.statement: Crossplane v2.0 requires sequential upgrade through intermediate v1 minor versions, with mandatory upgrade to v1.20 as the final v1 step before upgrading to v2.0; direct upgrade from earlier v1 versions to v2.0 is not supported.

decision.reason: [ev-8df0afdc905e] describes an operator upgrade step: go through one v1 minor version at a time and be on v1.20 before upgrading to v2.0, because each minor upgrade migrates Crossplane's CRDs to their latest stored versions. That makes the migration family the right subject family. The name "sequential-upgrade-v1-to-v2" is a short kebab-case identifier built from the evidence's own words (upgrade, sequentially, v1, v2.0). Migration-required is the only change type the migration family allows. I did not check consequence or applicability, so the evidence's "strongly advised" wording is not judged here.
